key_impacts: Tsunami flooding covered more than 200 square miles across coastal cities.
A nuclear meltdown occurred in Fukushima following the earthquake and tsunami.
Northern Japan was devastated by the cascading disaster.
evidence_snippets: Great Eastern Earthquake, triggering the tsunami and subsequent Fukushima nuclear meltdown that devastated northern Japan on March 11, 2011.
The tsunami that accompanied the Great Eastern Earthquake flooded more than 200 square miles of land across cities along Japan’s coastline.
